{{For|the American swimmer|Steve Bigelow}}
{{short description|Australian mathematician}}
{{Use dmy dates|cs1-dates=ly|date=April 2022}}
[[File:Stephen Bigelow.jpg|thumb|right|Stephen Bigelow]]
'''Stephen John Bigelow''' is an Australian mathematician and professor of mathematics at the [[University of California, Santa Barbara]].<ref name="cv">{{citation|url=http://math.ucsb.edu/~bigelow/job/cv.pdf|title=Stephen Bigelow: Curriculum Vitae|accessdate=2015-11-23}}.</ref> He is known for his proof that [[braid group]]s are [[matrix group|linear]], concurrently with and independently of another proof by Daan Krammer.<ref>{{citation
 | last = Bigelow | first = Stephen J.
 | doi = 10.1090/S0894-0347-00-00361-1
 | issue = 2
 | journal = Journal of the American Mathematical Society
 | mr = 1815219
 | pages = 471–486
 | title = Braid groups are linear
 | volume = 14
 | year = 2001| doi-access = free
 }}. Featured review in [[MathSciNet]] by Darryl McCullough.</ref>

Bigelow earned bachelor's and master's degrees in 1992 and 1994 from the [[University of Melbourne]].<ref name="cv"/> He completed his PhD in 2000 from the [[University of California, Berkeley]] under the joint supervision of [[Robion Kirby]] and [[Andrew Casson]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=44868}}</ref> He returned to Melbourne for two years as a research fellow before joining the UCSB faculty in 2002.<ref name="cv"/>

Bigelow was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 2002, speaking on [[Group representation|representations]] of braid groups.<ref>{{citation|url=http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php|title=ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers since 1897|publisher=[[International Mathematical Union]]|accessdate=2015-11-23}}.</ref> He was a [[Sloan Research Fellowship|Sloan Research Fellow]] for 2002–2006.<ref name="cv"/> In 2012 he was designated as one of the inaugural [[fellow]]s of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{citation|url=http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list|title=List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society|accessdate=2015-11-23}}.</ref>
